snippet.title: （Latest demo available）Official Trailer--English
snippet.description:
Demon Lord: Just a Block! is a 2D cartoon-style action roguelike that blends real-time action thrills with tactical turn-based combat.
You play as the decapitated head of the Demon Lord. On your journey to reclaim the throne, you must fight, build your deck, and make crucial choices to rally your old legions, challenge the usurper, Black Dragon Queen, and uncover the truth behind your seal.
No lightning-fast reflexes required—just snappy pacing, deep strategy, and a unique mix of humor and dark fantasy.

Search Demon Lord: Just a Block on Steam and play the latest demo.
Wishlist the game if you like it!
